\section{Results}\label{sec:results}

\begin{tcolorbox}
The panels lost about four per cent of their output in the hottest weeks, as \cref{tab:output} shows.
\end{tcolorbox}

The inverter logged its output every five minutes, \hlnote{which is more than enough} for a daily total.
